name: opencode
text: Paying for an AI coding app? There's a free, open-source one. It's called OpenCode, and it runs right in your terminal. Plug in Claude, GPT or Gemini, from over 75 providers. Already pay for GitHub Copilot? Log in and use that plan. Or run local models with Ollama and pay nothing for the AI. Press Tab for Plan mode. It reads your code, but won't edit it. Comment OPENCODE and I'll send you the link.

name: claude7
text: Most people use Claude Code like a chat box. These seven commands change that. One: slash B-T-W. Ask a side question without filling your context. Two: press Escape twice to roll back to an earlier checkpoint. Three: slash compact. It summarizes the chat to free up context. Four: slash context shows what's eating your context window. Five: Shift Tab switches to plan mode. Read only, no edits. Six: Control R searches your old prompts. Seven: slash simplify reviews your recent changes and fixes them. Comment CLAUDE and I'll send you the full cheat sheet.
